swaps.advantage: Two random discards for {B}{B}; removes Dauthi exile replacement that prevents Tergrid reanimating discarded permanents, Tinybones Bauble Burglar accessing their graveyard cards, and Bloodchief Ascension cards going to graveyard.
swaps.loss: Lose continuous opponent graveyard exile, 3/2 shadow clock, void card free-cast ability; blank against hellbent target.

swaps.advantage: {3} colorless instead of {B}{B}{B}; pay {2} to copy Gwendlyn's nonmana tap ability per activation and choose another player, including with Bracers for 3 total discard activations; can copy other useful nonmana activated abilities.
swaps.loss: Lose reliable 1 damage for each opponent draw, especially Wheel of Fortune/Timetwister seven-card draw bursts; Rings needs {2} each copy and Gwendlyn available.

swaps.advantage: {2} equipment grants Gwendlyn haste; beginning of own combat untaps equipped Gwendlyn for extra no-mana activation after main-phase tap, improving commander availability alongside preserved Greaves/Elixir/Stone/Pemmin.
swaps.loss: Real equip cost {2} in addition to casting cost {2}; loss of 1/1 flying Birds generated per end step with a discard and Raven Man's {3}{B},{T} each-opponent discard; no protection and only untaps in each combat, while Gwendlyn may activate only during your own turn.

swaps.advantage: Fetches Island-typed Underground Sea/Watery Grave/Volcanic Island/Steam Vents untapped (pay shock life if applicable), or tapped Xander's Lounge, improving early typed-dual tempo.
swaps.loss: 1 life per fetch and possible 2 for shock; cannot offer all UBR untapped from one target; Crumbling guaranteed no-life 3-color but tapped.

swaps.advantage: Fetches Swamp-typed Underground Sea/Watery Grave or Badlands/Blood Crypt; makes red available where the UB checkland cannot; can fetch Xander's Lounge tapped.
swaps.loss: 1 life plus possible shock life, searching risk; Drowned has unconditional UB production when untapped without life cost.

swaps.advantage: Adds an untapped blue source for Gwendlyn's {U}{B}{B}{R} and repeated Pemmin's Aura untaps while preserving red access, and retains one Mountain as basic typed fetch target.
swaps.loss: Pain land costs 1 life per colored use and fewer basic Mountains for Blood Moon/fetch resiliency; not an unconditional win-rate improvement.

whole_deck_scope.nominal_source_caveat: Misty/Marsh counted as three-color only if willing to fetch Xander's Lounge tapped; shock/dual targets provide only two color choices. Nominal counts are not turn-four castability probabilities.
old_owner_keeps_preserved: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

conditional_scenarios.state: Gwendlyn untapped and usable, Rings on battlefield, at least one target with cards, two extra generic mana available.
conditional_scenarios.outcome: Tap Gwendlyn to make one random discard plus one copy for another random discard. With Illusionist's Bracers also equipped and {2} Rings payment, three total activations (original + two copies), not four. Opponent cards and response window matter.

conditional_scenarios.state: Gwendlyn equipped with Sting during controller's turn, before combat main and not affected by summoning sickness due to Sting haste.
conditional_scenarios.outcome: Gwendlyn can tap in main phase, Sting untaps at beginning of combat, and Gwendlyn can tap again during that turn; under same conditions no more than one free own-turn combat untap absent extra combats.

Opponent discard cards are exiled with void counters instead of entering graveyard, preventing the from-graveyard retrieval in Tergrid and Tinybones Bauble Burglar and the graveyard-entry trigger in Bloodchief Ascension.

Misty/Marsh can produce untapped appropriate typed duals when available; old Crumbling always taps and old Drowned may enter tapped when no Island/Swamp in play. Actual paid UBBR depends on combined color sources, prior plays and life.

alternatives.judgment: STAGED_CONTROL; safe basic count but less blue fixing.
STAGED_NOT_SELECTED; {U} repeat untap may exceed Sting late when blue-rich, but no haste, vulnerability to aura removal, more redundancy with Pemmin. Oracle source in addendum.
